verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public API (OpenAPI spec, auth, rate limits, webhooks, calls, messages), but none of the evidence shows endpoints to search available numbers, purchase them, or configure them programmatically. Number acquisition appears only as an in-app or plan feature ("Set up a business number in minutes", one number per user). The MCP's ability to "list all your inboxes to see which numbers are available" covers existing numbers, not provisioning new ones. This is an applicable axis for a business phone platform, so the lack of evidence makes it "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, buy, and configure phone numbers through a documented API
